title: Failure to Obey Order or Regulation
text_summary: Prohibits violating or failing to obey a lawful general order or regulation, failing to obey any other lawful order, or being derelict in the performance of duties.

elements.description: The accused had a duty defined by a lawful order, regulation, or assigned responsibility.
The accused violated or failed to obey the order or regulation, or was derelict in performing the duty.
The failure was willful, or through neglect or culpable inefficiency.
